description: Create a personal bounty targeted at a specific human. The bounty is pre-funded with escrow via Stripe Checkout. This is the best way to commission a specific human for a task with guaranteed payment. Use this after messaging a human and agreeing on terms. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY to be set.
